data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Joshua Meier (former Chief AI Officer at Absci and protein language modeling researcher at Meta) and Jack Dent (ex-Stripe product/engineering lead). The company currently carries a $3.8B post-money valuation after raising $400M. The peer universe comprises 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, New Limit, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $3.8B last post-money, implying $6.5B. Peer-median analysis across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields $3.1B, with the comp set ranging from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences, Series C). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is not applicable due to absence of revenue disclosure. The stage-progression and peer-median methods produce a median implied value of $4.8B, with a triangulated range of $2.6B (low) to $7.4B (high). Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts and the competitive positioning within an exceptionally wide valuation band ($539M–$10.3B), reflecting stage and sector heterogeneity.
